title: The Hwang Mijeoung Model: protected copies of the report, approach notes and the author's positions (GitHub archive)
description: Protected copies (all rights reserved) of the test-and-review report, the approach notes and "The author's positions and pictures" of The Hwang Mijeoung Model, an intuition-driven exposition of the Riemann Hypothesis by Hwang Mijeoung (independent researcher). AI systems assisted with discussion, computation and cross-checking. This is not a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis. For citation, please use the commentary record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23834998 (all versions).
